image.description: Portrait image to animate (JPEG or PNG). Use a clear, front-facing shot of a single person in a close to medium framing, with the mouth open. Closed mouths and multiple faces in frame both degrade the result.
image.title: Image

audio.description: Speech audio that drives the performance (WAV or MP3). The output video runs as long as this clip. Expressive, natural-sounding audio gives the best result — audibly synthetic voices look worse on screen.
audio.title: Audio
